caption: The drawing features a square composition with a large eight-pointed star filling most of the central area. The background is a light cream color decorated with evenly spaced blue polka dots. The star is made up of many smaller triangles arranged in a patchwork pattern, and these triangles display a variety of colors and designs. The predominant colors within the star are red, blue, and pink, with some patterned triangles featuring stripes, dots, floral motifs, and checkered designs in those colors. The boundaries of the star are delineated by the edges of its component triangles, creating sharp geometric lines that contrast with the dot-patterned background. The overall look is orderly, with the star centered and symmetrical within the square. A double-lined border in dark blue surrounds the inner composition.
title: Quilt - "Eastern Star"
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
